open.speaker: Mira
open.text: New face. Sit anywhere that isn't wet.

regular.speaker: Mira
regular.text: Back again. Fire's lit, rooms are up the stairs, and I've heard every shipwreck story twice.

rooms.speaker: Mira
rooms.text: Four rooms, four beds, one of them doesn't creak. Four marks a night and I don't ask names.

rumour.speaker: Mira
rumour.text: Kesk down at the harbour has been muttering about his ledger for a week. Man could have walked up here in the time he's spent complaining.

ledger.speaker: Mira
ledger.text: Kesk sent you. Of course he did.

ledger_choice.speaker: Mira
ledger_choice.text: He wants a signature. What he'll get is a signature and an opinion.

opinion.speaker: Mira
opinion.text: That harbour dues went up twice this year and the harbour did not.

sign.speaker: Mira
sign.text: There. Tell him it's signed under protest, and tell him the protest is in writing.

sign_end.speaker: Mira
sign_end.text: Go on, back down the hill. He'll be pretending he wasn't watching the door.

after_signed.speaker: Mira
after_signed.text: Kesk's still waiting on that ledger. Downhill, can't miss him, he's the one shaped like a complaint.

paid.speaker: Mira
paid.text: He paid you? Then the day's already unusual. First one's on the house -- sit by the fire.
